$comment: Feed registry for scripts/fetch-feeds.js. Operator-owned like known_outlets.json — the pipeline RUNS the script (npm run fetch:feeds) but never edits this file. 'outlet' must equal a canonical name or alias in known_outlets.json (tier is looked up at runtime, not stored here — single source of truth). Order matters: feeds are processed top-to-bottom and dedupe keeps the FIRST copy of a headline, so keep tier-1 outlets first. Set enabled:false to bench a feed without losing its entry. MAINTENANCE: re-point the gdelt-* queries whenever project-memory/theaters-registry.md reframes the arcs — a static query set silently drifts off-target when the arc framing changes (as it did 2026-05-23). Watch automation/research/feed-health-log.jsonl for feed rot; items_kept:0 on an ok feed means it serves only stale content (prune candidate).
changelog_2026-10-20: Operator-directed after a deep sweep found the daily runs missing cold-war-style tension precursors (espionage, sabotage, posture, Indo-Pacific, Arctic, economic coercion). (1) Window is now adaptive: back to the previous digest + overlap_hours, floor window_hours, cap max_window_hours (the ~60h run gate left ~1.5 days of every gap uncovered). (2) flag_categories added beside the legacy kinetic flag_terms; non-kinetic hits are listed first in the headlines view as 'tension-precursor leads'. (3) 19 feeds added, probed live 2026-10-20 (HTTP 200, current items). Outlets marked lead-only are NOT in known_outlets.json: they widen discovery but cannot be cited until Jake approves a tier.

changelog_2026-11-10: Operator-approved after the 2026-11-10 coverage audit. (1) Watch regions widened to the Horn of Africa, Sudan, Iraq, Afghanistan/Pakistan, the Caucasus, Libya, the DRC, the Sahel and Latin America; "georgia" replaced by tbilisi/georgian dream (it fired on US election results). Yemen/Houthi deliberately NOT added: they are arc topics. "mali" is matched as bamako / in mali / mali's (bare "mali" hits Somalia). (2) New categories: diplomatic (D: ruptures, legal and domestic-stability process) and macro (M: rates, inflation, energy, currency). (3) USGS items never count as watch-region leads (earthquakes). (4) per_feed_cap 30->60 and global_cap 700->900, with a higher ceiling in fetch-feeds.js, so the rolling feed store (fetch-feeds.js --accumulate every 4h) reaches the digest. (5) Yonhap, Japan Times, LRT, ERR News, gCaptain, Breaking Defense, The Diplomat and DW are now in known_outlets.json at 4-specialty.
